sourceNote: Placeholder corpus pending a Superteam Sui chapter or equivalent regional builder DAO. Skills should treat this list as supplementary; sui-native-gaps and a16z-state-of-crypto-2026 carry the bulk of the corpus until this source matures.

ideas.title: Region-specific stablecoin on-ramp
ideas.summary: Localized fiat-to-USDC on-ramp with partner banks in one region. Sui as the on-chain settlement layer.
ideas.fitForSui: Sui's USDC native plus sponsored tx removes wallet friction for users new to crypto.
ideas.marketSignal: Stablecoin adoption in emerging markets is climbing; localized on-ramps remain underbuilt.

ideas.title: Builder bounty board with on-chain escrow
ideas.summary: Bounty marketplace where payment lives in a Sui escrow object, released by a milestone capability.
ideas.fitForSui: Sui escrow objects plus capability-gated release model bounties cleanly. PTBs settle disputes atomically.
ideas.marketSignal: Bounty platforms (Replit, Superteam Earn) prove demand; on-chain escrow is the unmet primitive.

ideas.title: Creator tipping with on-chain receipts
ideas.summary: Lightweight tipping product for creators. Sponsored tx, zkLogin, every tip becomes a kiosk receipt.
ideas.fitForSui: Sui's UX stack (zkLogin plus sponsored gas) is the only L1 that delivers Venmo-grade tipping flow.
ideas.marketSignal: Creator tipping (Twitter Tip Jar, Cash App) has retention; crypto-native equivalents are wallet-blocked.

ideas.title: Event ticketing with kiosk-based resale
ideas.summary: Tickets minted as kiosk objects. Resale rules enforced by capability. Anti-scalping by design.
ideas.fitForSui: Kiosk's transfer policy primitive enforces resale rules at the protocol layer, not in app code.
ideas.marketSignal: Ticket scalping is a billion-dollar global problem; existing crypto attempts have not stuck.
